source: For a long moment, as Sam beheld the multitude of enemies scaling the wall in different ways, jumping, climbing or, in one case, gliding over it, he got scared.
target: Diuturno tempore, dum Sam multitudinem hostium spectabat murum variis modis ascendere—saltantibus, scandentibus, aut, in uno casu, planatim transvolantibus—territus est.

source: Not of the enemies.
target: Non hostium.

source: He had already managed to beat it into his head that it was a game and not real, but instead, he got scared of himself.
target: Iam se convincerat id ludum esse, non rem veram; sed proinde se ipsum metu affectum esse sensit.

source: Because, the moment he saw the enemies, all he felt was elation.
target: Nam, momento quo hostes aspexit, totum quod sensit, exsultatio erat.

source: Elation about finally fighting beings smarter than rocks.
target: Exsultatio erat de tandem pugnando contra creaturas sapientioribus quam lapides.

source: Beings that could challenge him.
target: Creaturae quae eum provocare poterant.

source: Beat him even (not that he wanted that)…
target: Eum etiam superare (non enim hoc optabat)…

source: It scared him a little how much the game changed him.
target: Eum paulum terruit, quantum ludus eum mutaverit.

source: How much this opportunity that fell into his lap changed him.
target: Quantum haec occasio, quae in sinu eius cecidit, eum mutaverit.

source: Then he had to stop the introspection as he was beset by several mooks for the lack of a better word.
target: Tum introspectionem relinquere debuit, cum ab pluribus ministris ignobilibus (verbo meliore deficiente) oppressus esset.

source: They were indistinguishable from each other, wearing black, all‑body concealing clothing, only a few of them having a few spikes on their shoulders that set them aside from the others.
target: Inter se non distinguibiles erant, vestimenta nigra gerentes quae totum corpus tegebant, solum pauci ex eis in umeris aculeos habebant, qui eos a reliquis distinguebant.

source: Sam instantly pegged them as team leaders, because his Mana Sight told him they had a marginally bigger amount of mana than the regular mooks.
target: Sam statim eos duces esse reputavit, quoniam Vis Arcanae eius indicavit eos paululum maiorem vim arcanae habere quam ministri ordinarii.

source: Then there were the players.
target: Deinde erant lusores.

source: Of course, they were smart enough to dress up the same as the mooks currently menacing the guards while the maids crowded next to the wall of the manor, clutching their hands and trying to keep quiet and out of the way, but to Sam, it was obvious who they were.
target: Scilicet, callidi satis erant ut eandem vestem induerent, quales mooks, qui nunc custodes minabant, induti essent, dum ancillae iuxta murum manerii congregabant, manus prehendentes et silentium servare conantes; sed Sam illos esse perspicuum habebat.

source: Their mana was unique for every one of them, showing that it was made from several distinct parts, telling Sam that they probably didn’t bother to harmonize their skills and spells.
target: Vis arcana eorum unice in singulis apparuit, ostendens eam ex pluribus partibus distinctis compositam esse, quae Sam indicabat eos verisimiliter non curavisse artes et incantationes suas harmonizare.

source: ‘Probably went for what is cool…’ He scoffed a little, then for a second watched as all the players, without saying a word, began circling the lord of the manor, who was already beset by several mooks.
target: ‘Forsitan optaverunt id quod mirabile videbatur…’ leviter irridens, deinde per momentum observavit omnes lusores, sine verbo, dominum manerii circuitantes, qui a pluribus mooks iam oppresserat.

source: “Haha! You think you can defeat ME?” came the boisterous laugh as the man somehow conjured giant metal gauntlets on his equally gigantic fist and punched them together.
target: “Haha! Existimasne te ME vincere posse?” exclamavit, dum ille nonnullo modo ingentes gauntulas metallorum super pugno suo convocavit et inter se pulsavit.

source: “COME AND SEE!” He roared, but before he could launch himself at the enemy, Sam decided to call out to him.
target: “Veni et vide!” fremuit, sed priusquam in hostem se propellet, Sam eum vocare constituit.

source: “Go for the spikes! They’re the leaders!”
target: “Ad aculeos age! Illi duces sunt!”

source: He saw the mooks visibly flinch at that, and the lord just laughed, ignored the nearest minion that he was originally targeting and jumped towards one of the attackers wearing spikes on his shoulder.
target: Vidit mooks palam pallere, et dominus rideo, proximum ministrum quem primo destinaverat neglexit, et in unum ex aggressoribus, qui aculeos in umero gerebat, saltavit.

source: Unfortunately, Sam didn’t have much time to observe Lord Silvercrest’s fight because several enemy attackers and one of the players (standing in the back) began to menace him.
target: Infeliciter, Sam non multum temporis habuit ad bellum Domini Silvercrest contemplandum, quia quidam hostium aggressores et unus lusorum (in tergo stans) eum minari coeperunt.

source: He gave them a smile, his sword ready for the fight, and made a ‘come here’ motion with his free hand.
target: Illis subridens, gladium ad pugnam paratum habens, cum manu libera motum “veni huc” effecit.

source: The nameless mooks remained silent, but he heard the players scoff.
target: Mooks innominati silentium retinuerunt, sed audivit lusores irridere.

source: Sam smiled and deflected a clean strike, aiming for his jugular, then sidestepped another aiming for his heart, then simply took another back, pivoting and striking at one of the black‑clad minions that were surrounding him.
target: Sam subridens ictum purum deflexit, in jugulum intendens; deinde alium transiecit, in cor petens; et postea retro celeriter se movit, vertebatque et in unum ex ministris nigro vestiti, qui eum circumdederant, percussit.

source: Sadly, they didn’t do the usual evil minion thing of attacking one at a time, so he had to pay a lot of attention to where they were aiming.
target: Tristiter, non secutae sunt consuetudines maleficae ministrorum unius post alium oppugnandi, ita ut ei multum attendendum esset quo intendebantur.

source: Ignoring the crashes in the background as the loud lord of the manor rampaged around and as the guards yelled and grunted while fighting the fodder, he danced between the blades of his enemy, keeping one eye on them and another on the player that seemed to be positioning himself for a one‑strike kill.
target: Neglegens ruinas in fundo, dum altus dominus manerii strepitabat et custodes clamabant, pabulum pugnantes, inter laminas hostis saltavit, unum oculum in eos spectans et alterum in lusorem, qui se ad ictum mortiferum parare videbatur, intendens.

source: Parry, step, parry, pivot, jump a little, step forward, slash and turn, and so on, and on and on…
target: Parry, passus, parry, verti, paulum sali, in antegradum progrediere, caedere et convertere, et ita pergit…

source: Sam could have broken out his spells, but for some reason, the minions were only using weapons and he wanted to know why.
target: Sam incantationes suas pronuntare poterat, sed, quocumque causa, ministri solum arma utebantur; idque scire cupiebat.

source: Oddly, he couldn’t sense anything with his Mana Sense.
target: Mirum quidem, nihil per Sensus Vis Arcanae sentire poterat.

source: ‘Maybe they didn’t want to attract the attention of the rest of the city?’ he wondered as idly sidestepped a strike, continuing the motion of his sword, and lopped the head off of the minion that overextended himself.
target: ‘Forsitan noluerunt reliquae urbis attentionem attrahere?’ mirabatur, dum leviter ictum vitabat, gladium in motu perseverans, et caput ministri, qui se nimis extulerat, abscidit.

source: “One down,” he spoke, hoping to get some reaction from the mooks.
target: “Unus deiectus,” inquit, sperans aliquam reactionem ab illis accipere.

source: But while he could see slight tensing of their bodies, they didn’t react.
target: Sed, quamquam levem tensionem corporum eorum intuari poterat, non responserunt.

source: There was some kind of explosion behind his back, some boisterous laughter, and with a small smile, Sam continued.
target: Explosio aliqua in tergo facta est, et risus strepitosus audiebatur, et cum parvo subridente, Sam pergebat.

source: “My apologies. Seven down.”
target: “Mea culpa. Septem deiecti sunt.”

source: One of the black‑clad mooks raised their dagger, an ugly and dangerous‑looking thing with hooks and teeth everywhere, and suddenly it was bathed in a black light that felt very familiar to Sam.
target: Unus e mooks nigro vestitis gladium sublevavit, rem turpem et periculosam, uncinis et dentibus ubique ornatam, et subito in lucem nigrum, quae Sam nota videbatur, immersum est.

source: ‘So, they were responsible for this…’
target: ‘Ita, ipsi hoc causa erant…’

source: He didn’t wait for his enemy to do anything with that black light, knowing how insidious it was, and with a quick movement, slashed with his sword several times, combining Mana Slash and Wind Flurry several times, aimed at the probable man with the freaky dagger.
target: Non exspectavit hostem quidquid cum illa luce nigra faceret, sciens quam perfida esset, et celeriter gladium suum pluries ictu percusso, coniungens Mana Slash et Wind Flurry, verisimilem virum cum gladium insolitum intendens.

source: Before the rest of them could react, the extremely fast attack crashed into a barrier made of the same light that enveloped the dagger previously.
target: Antequam reliqui responderent, immodicus et celerissimus ictus in obex ex eadem luce, quae gladium prius involverat, concurrit.

source: The two forces fought against each other, but in the end, Sam was Sam and his enemy was a mook.
target: Duae vires inter se certaverunt, sed in fine, Sam erat Sam, et hostis eius erat unus ex ministris ignobilibus.

source: The barrier shattered and the upper body of the assailant fell apart, cut into apple‑sized chunks.
target: Obex confractus est, et corpus superius oppugnatoris in fragmenta, magnitudine malorum, divisum est.

source: He had time to grimace and chastise himself for being needlessly gruesome before the rest of the mooks, visibly angry at the death of their comrade, fell on him, their weapons in the process of being enveloped by the cloying miasma that Sam was beginning to hate.
target: Tempus habuit ut vultum contraxisset et se reprehendisset ob inutile crudelitatem, antequam reliqui mooks, palam irati propter sodalis mortem, in eum incidissent, armis suis in miasma suffocante involventibus.

source: ‘I’m totally getting a purifying skill after this…’
target: ‘Post hoc, certe artem purificantem adipiscar…’

source: He increased the mana flowing into his Mana Shield, then began to deflect the attacks coming.
target: Auguit vim arcanae in suo Scuto Arcana, deinde impetus instantes deflectere coepit.

source: Then he felt a sudden pulse of mana.
target: Tum repente impetum vis arcanae sensit.

source: The mooks around him froze, and the player in the back exclaimed.
target: Mooks, qui eum circumiacabantur, congelaverunt, et lusor in tergo exclamavit.

source: “Dark Bullet: Extreme Strength!”
target: “Telum Obscurum: Robur Extremum!”

source: In front of their outstretched hand was a globe of dark energy, partly made of miasma, and partly from what seemed liquid darkness.
target: Ante manum eorum extensam erat globus energiae obscurae, partim ex miasma confectus, et partim ex eo quod tenebra liquida videbatur.

source: It hung there for a millisecond, and then it was launched directly at Sam and the mooks surrounding him.
target: Illic per brevissimum tempus manebat, deinde directe in Sam et in mooks circum eum missum est.

source: Sam barely had a second to react.
target: Sam vix momentum habuit ut reagere posset.

source: “Wind Jump!”
target: “Saltus Ventorum!”

source: He was just fast enough that the rapidly approaching (and expanding) ball of eldritch energy barely brushed the bottom of his feet, smashing apart the top layer of his mana shield before slamming into the ground and exploding with extreme speed.
target: Erat tam velox ut globus, celeriter appropinquans et expandens energiae arcanae, vix limen pedum eius attingeret, superiorem laminae scuti arcani diruens, antequam in terram iactus et cum extrema celeritate explodiret.

source: The mooks didn’t even have time to scream before they were consumed.
target: Mooks vix tempus habuerunt ad clamandum, antequam devorati essent.

source: ‘Thank god for Flow…’
target: Deo gratias pro Flow.

source: Sending a prayer to RNGods for giving him the skill, he watched as the player was enveloped with the miasma, and his hand lit up again, though thankfully this time the ball was much smaller.
target: Precatum ad RNGods mittens, qui ei hanc facultatem dederat, observavit sicut lusor in miasma involutus est, et manus eius iterum lucebat, quamvis hoc tempore globus multo minor esset.

source: “Dark Bullet! Dark Bullet! Dark Bullet!”
target: “Telum Obscurum! Telum Obscurum! Telum Obscurum!”

source: Three bullets were launched at him, and seeing as he was still in the air he simply raised his sword and once again slashed many times, sending a wind‑enhanced storm of flurry against the approaching projectiles at the same moment he reached the apex of his jump.
target: Tria tela in eum iaciebantur, et videns se adhuc in aere esse, gladium suum levavit atque iterum pluries caedens, turbine venti amplificata procella flurry contra appropinquantia projectilia iaciens, eodem momento quo in apicem saltus pervenit.

source: The moment the storm of wind reached the bullet, the two attacks clashed, and the storm chewed up the dark magic like a certain worm eating the sand of a certain planet.
target: Mox, cum tempestas venti telum attigeret, duo impetus concurrerunt, et tempestas obscuram magiam masticavit, velut vermis arenam ex certo planeta edens.

source: And because he barely put any power into it, the spell dissipated before it could reach the player.
target: Et quia vix aliquam vim illi intulit, incantatio evanuit antequam ad lusorem pervenire posset.

source: Visibly angry, the man began to fire more and more bullets of dark magic as the miasma began to grow around.
target: Vir manifeste iratus coepit plura tela magiae obscurae iacere, cum miasma circa eum crescit.

source: As he began to fall, he glanced around, taking in the situation.
target: Dum cadere incipiebat, circumspiciebat et rem contemplabatur.

source: Lord Silvercrest (he really needed to learn his first name) was currently fighting against three players also bathed in the dark miasma, while several mooks with spikes on their clothing were taking potshots at the man.
target: Dominus Silvercrest (primum nomen eius discendum erat) nunc contra tres lusores, qui quoque in miasma obscurum immersi erant, pugnabat, dum plures mooks, aculeos in vestimentis gerentes, impetum in hominem iacebant.

source: The ritual was still ongoing, though the wizard was visibly straining based on the beads of sweat running down his face.
target: Ritus adhuc celebrabatur, quamquam magus palam sudore guttulis a facie eius fluentibus laborabat.

source: The lady of the house was alive but seemed to writhe as black smoke seemed to be rising from her body.
target: Domina domus viva erat, sed videbatur contorta, cum niger fumus e corpore eius surgere videbatur.

source: He landed on his feet, not far from the small crater left behind by the overpowered attack, and sent another flurry of wind blades, canceling the continuously increasing amount of Dark Bullets.
target: In pedes descendit, non procul a parvo cratere relicto post ictum potentissimum, et aliam procellam laminarum venti misit, quantitatem telorum obscurorum continue crescentem evellens.

source: Eyeing the other man, he waited until he began to chant again.
target: Alium hominem intueri, exspectavit donec iterum incantare coepit.

source: “Dark Bullet! Dark Bullet! DARK BULLET!”
target: “Telum Obscurum! Telum Obscurum! TELUM OBSCURUM!”

source: And launched his own Wind Bullet with a soft whisper.
target: Et suum Telum Venti, cum tenuissimo susurro, iacuit.

source: While he didn’t know how to cast the spell without the verbal trigger, there was no need to yell like the idiot in front of him.
target: Cum nesciret quomodo incantationem sine verbo activante evocaret, non necessarium erat clamare sicut stulte coram eo.

source: “Wind Bullet.”
target: “Telum Venti.”

source: “DARK BULLET! DARK BULLET! DARK BULL-”
target: “TELUM OBSCURUM! TELUM OBSCURUM! TELUM OBSCU-”

source: The bullet of wind struck the other man’s barrier, disrupting his casting and causing the dozen small balls of corrupting darkness in front of him to dissipate with an oddly disappointed hiss.
target: Telum venti obex alterius hominis percussit, incantationem eius interrumpens atque duodecim parvas globulos corruptae tenebris ante eum dissipatos faciens, cum sibilo insolito decepto.

source: Though he wasn’t hurt, the man became very angry.
target: Etsi non laesus erat, vir valde iratus factus est.

source: “What the hell?! Why won’t you die? I did all of…” he visibly swallowed his last words but it was enough for Sam.
target: “Quid di immortales?! Cur non morieris? Omnia feci…” inquit, ultima verba palam subtrahens, sed id Sam satis videbatur.

source: His enemy obviously completed some kind of quest to gain this kind of power.
target: Hostis eius perspicue aliquam quaestionem perfecit ad talem potentiam adipiscendam.

source: Dark magic wasn’t exactly uncommon, but it was considered one of the ‘evil magics’ in the world of Magic Unbound that required rather specific sacrifices to upgrade.
target: Magia obscura non ita rara erat, sed inter “magias malas” in mundo Magic Unbound habita est, quae sacrificia specialia requirebat ad meliorationem.

source: In exchange, it granted rather potent powers even at the beginning.
target: Pro illis, etiam initio, potentissimas virtutes largiebatur.

source: Which he didn’t see in the opponent before him.
target: Quae ipse in adversario coram se non observabat.

source: However, as he observed the man, it seemed that he also came to a decision.
target: Tamen, dum hominem observabat, videbatur etiam consilium cepisse.

source: “It seems I have to use my full power!”
target: “Videtur mihi totam vim meam adhibere oportere!”

source: Physically cringing at the man, he primed his own spell, then launched several Wind Flurries mixed with Mana Slashes at the man.
target: Physice contritus, gladium suum cum vis arcana involvens, et deinde plures Turbina Ventorum cum Mana Slash mixtos in hominem iacuit.

source: This time, at maximum power. It was high time to finish it.
target: Hoc tempore, ad maximum impetum; tempus erat id finire.

source: To his disappointment, the moment his spell reached the man, it crashed into the dark barrier and gave his opponent enough time for a yell.
target: Ad eius delusionem, mox incantatio eius ad hominem perveniens in obex obscurum concurrit, et adversario satis tempus dedit ut clamaret.

source: “Dark Shroud!”
target: “Tegmen Obscurum!”

source: The miasma enveloping the man intensified enough that Sam could feel and see the waves of black mana radiating from the man.
target: Miasma, quod hominem involverat, ita intensum factum est ut Sam fluctus vis arcanae nigrae, a viro radiantes, sentire et videre possent.

source: “Now take THIS!”
target: “Nunc accipe hoc!”

source: “Dark Beam!”
target: “Radius Obscurus!”

source: The moment he heard the man speak, he crouched down and slammed his hand down on the ground, creating an Earth Wall.
target: In momento quo vir loqui audivit, se incurvatum fecerit et manum in terram dejecit, murum terrae creando.

source: The beam crashed into it and Sam had to fight continuously against the corrosive black mana that seemed intent on eating away his mana.
target: Radius incidit in murum, et Sam continenter pugnare oportuit contra corrosivam vim arcanae nigrae, quae manifeste vellebatur manum eius consumere.

source: But thanks to his Mana Disruption, the freaky mana that seemed to destroy anything it came in contact with couldn’t get a hold of his wall of reinforced earth.
target: Sed gratias Disruptione Vis Arcanae eius, vis arcana insueta, quae quicquid attingebat deleere videbatur, murum terrae roboratae eius capere non potuit.

source: After several seconds of intense bombardment, the beam let up, and despite the fight going on around them, Sam could hear the aggravated breathing of his opponent.
target: Post aliquot secundas intenses bombardationis, radius cessavit, et, quamquam pugnatum circa eos continuabat, Sam audire potuit aggravatam respirationem hostis sui.

source: “WHY! WON’T! YOU! DIE!” came the almost incoherent yelling, but Sam ignored it.
target: “CUR! NON! MORI! VELIS!” exclamabant, sed Sam id neglexit.

source: Carefully encasing his blade with Mana, and after a soft whisper with Wind Edge, he spoke two words.
target: Cautissime gladium suum cum vis arcana involvens, et post mollissimum susurro cum Wind Edge, duas verba locutus est.

source: “Shadow Burst!”
target: “Exruptio Umbrae!”

source: With the increased speed, he had time to jump away from his cover as another beam, twice the size of the previous one, slammed into the location he was at, obliterating everything in its path, while he winced at the feeling as the dark mana pulsing from the enemy player increased once again.
target: Cum velocitate aucta, tempus habuit ut a tegmine se abstraheret, dum alter radius, duplo magnitudine praecedenti, in locum, ubi erat, incidens, cuncta in semita sua deleva, dum ipse dolore vultum contraxit, cum vis arcana obscura a lusore hostili pulsans iterum creverat.

source: ‘Apparently, he made a deal with somebody very important…’
target: ‘Manifestum est eum pacto cum aliquo valde importanti fecisse…’

source: The moment the mana increased in the man in front of him, so did in the others.
target: In momento quo vis arcana in viro coram eum creverat, idem in ceteris accidit.

source: ‘Or maybe with somebody, very very important…’
target: ‘Vel fortasse cum aliquo, valde valde importanti…’

source: “OH, COME ON!” came the frustrated yell of the lord who was about to break through their barriers while the rest of the mooks were resting in pieces around them.
target: “O, age!” exclamavit dominus, frustratus, qui ex imminenti obices rumpere parabat, dum reliqui mooks in particulis circa eos quiescebant.

source: Giving another quick glance at the ritual, he saw that smoke rising from the noble lady was increasing, as was the white flame in the chalice.
target: Aliam celerem conspectionem ritu faciens, vidit fumum ex domina nobilis surgere et augeri, sicut flamma alba in calyce.

source: Reaching the man in a second, he thrust his sword forward, pushing a Mana Strike to the very tip of the blade, trying to weave the spells he had on the sword.
target: Ad viro in momento accessit, gladium suum immisit, Mana Strike ad apicem laminae impellens, conans incantationes in gladio suis texere.

source: For a moment that felt like an eternity, Sam feared that he had failed and his sword was stopped by the churning barrier, but then ever so slowly, the sword began to slide forward, picking up speed and ending up in the assailant’s skull through the bottom of his mouth.
target: Per momentum, quod tam diu videbatur, Sam timebat se defecisse et gladium suum propter obex turbidum sisti, sed deinde paulatim gladium incedere coepit, celeritatem accipiens et tandem in calvariam oppugnatoris per infima ora perveniens.

source: For another long moment, the mana surrounding the man churned and spewed, obviously agitated, and Sam would have sworn it was angry at him, before the enemy player’s health vanished and with it, the connection to their patron.
target: Alio momento longo, vis arcana quae hominem circumdabatur, turbine se movebat et eructabat, manifeste commota, et Sam iuravisset eam ei irasse, antequam valitudo lusoris hostilis evanuit, et cum ea, conexio ad patronum eorum.

source: Sam let out a relieved sigh and yanked the sword out of the man, but he had to shake his head in disgust as the miasma began to eat away at it as soon as he stopped channeling mana through it.
target: Sam suspiravit exsolutus et gladium ex homine extraxit, sed caput in fastidio concutere oportuit, cum miasma coepit illud edere, simul ac mana per illud dirigere cessavit.

source: He threw it away and took out another sword from his inventory and turned his attention towards the other fight.
target: Illud abiicivit et alium gladium ex inventario tulit, et animos ad aliam pugnam vertit.

source: Sadly, the intensity of the mana surrounding them didn’t go down with the death of their comrade.
target: Tristiter, intensitas vis arcana quae eos circumdabatur, non cecidit cum sodalis eorum mortuus esset.

source: Hell, it seemed to have grown.
target: Immo, videbatur eam augeri.

source: Taking a stance, he waited for a lull in the fight.
target: Stans, exspectavit intervallum quietis in pugna.

source: It came soon as the fighting parties separated after another clash that left the dark‑clad side with ashen skin (where it could be seen through the rips of their clothing) showing that the incredible amount of uncontrolled mana seemed to have an actual price on their bodies.
target: Mox venit, cum partes pugnantes post aliam concursationem se separaverunt, quae parte nigro vestitam cum cutibus cineribus illustraverunt (per lacunas vestimentorum conspicuas), ostendens incredibilem quantitatem vis arcanae imparatae quasi pretium verum super corpora eorum habere.

source: While the Lord seemed to be in better shape, his gauntlets were starting to get corroded at certain points.
target: Dum Dominus in melioribus condicionibus videbatur, gauntuli eius in quibusdam partibus corrodi coeperunt.

source: Sam didn’t waste another second, already chastising himself for playing around at the beginning, and launched several Wind Flurries at the players trying to make him fail his quest.
target: Sam aliam secundam non perdidit, iam se reprimens quod initio luserat, et plures Turbina Ventorum in lusores misit, qui eum iter suum fallere conabantur.

source: It was mana intensive, but it was so worth it watching them smugly tanking with their barriers, and then seeing said barriers shredded by his Mana Disruption.
target: Erat intensum in vis arcana, sed multum aestimabatur, cum eos vidisset arroganter scuta gerentes, et deinde illa scuta per Disruptionem Vis Arcanae dissoluta.

source: They might have had enormous amounts of mana, but they didn’t even have an iota of control over it.
target: Fortasse ingentem quantitatem vis arcanae habebant, sed ne minimum quidem moderaminis eius possidebant.

source: Of the three players still alive, one of them was diced instantly and the second one got their barriers destroyed, which the lord immediately made use of, pouncing on the man, and turning him from 3D into 2D.
target: Ex tribus lusoribus adhuc viventibus, unus eorum statim deiectus est et alteri obices destructi sunt, quos dominus statim adhibuit, in hominem impetum faciens, eumque ex dimensione tridimensionali in bidimensionalem convertens.

source: The last man yelled something incoherently, but their barrier held.
target: Ultimus vir aliquid incoherent exclamavit, sed obex eorum sustinuit.

source: Then, as Sam was looking around for the suspiciously missing “boss encounter” the mana spiked once again and the man’s body seized up, freezing in place for a moment.
target: Tum, dum Sam circumspiciebat qua “boss encounter” suspecte deerat, vis arcana iterum subito crevit et corpus viri cohibitum est, per momentum congelatum.

source: When the episode was over, their body was relaxed, their eyes were pure black, and the previously fully chaotic mana around them began to swirl in a streamlined fashion that spoke of unbelievable control.
target: Cum episodio confecto esset, corpus eorum relaxatum erat, oculi eorum pura nigri erant, et vis arcana, quondam omnino chaotica, circa eos in ordine rotari coepit, quod incredibilem moderationem significabat.

source: The eyes roamed around, taking in everything, and Sam felt the breath freeze inside him as the eyes landed on him.
target: Oculi circum errabant, omnia capientes, et Sam sensit spiritum suum in se congelari, cum oculi in eum inciderunt.

source: “Befouler!” The voice that came out of the man resembled nothing like how a human would sound. It was deep, echo‑y but at the same time grating and high pitched.
target: “Profanator!” Vox, quae ex viro effluxit, nihil simile auditus humano habebat. Erat profunda, resonans, sed simul asperrima et acro tonis.

source: Despite the seriousness of the situation, Sam couldn’t help but roll his eyes.
target: Quamquam res gravis esset, Sam oculos vertere non potuit, irrisus tamen.

source: “Oh, it’s you…”
target: “O, tu es…”

source: Lord Silvercrest stepped up next to Sam cautiously, eyes never leaving the being that possessed the last enemy alive.
target: Dominus Silvercrest, cautus, iuxta Sam accessit, oculi numquam ab ente, quae ultimum hostem viventem possidebat, discedentibus.

source: “You know this… creature, my friend?”
target: “Scisne hanc creaturam, mi amice?”

source: “Guess who had the chalice?”
target: “Adivina, quis calycem obtinuerit?”

source: “I see…”
target: “Video…”

source: The monster opened the mouth of the human’s body, pointed at Sam, and once again roared.
target: Monstrum os hominis aperuit, ad Sam demonstravit, et iterum fremuit.

source: “BEFOULER!”
target: “PROFANATOR!”

source: And at the same moment, turned around and launched himself at the barrier protecting the lady of the house and the wizard performing.
target: Et eodem momento, se convertit et in obex, qui dominam domus et magum protegebat, se iactavit.

source: Sam launched several attacks, and the man standing next to him roared and jumped after the monster, but they were too slow.
target: Sam plura impetum iaculatus est, et vir iuxta eum fremuit et post monstrum salivit, sed nimis tarde erant.

source: The body reached the barrier with extreme speed and Sam felt a brief pulse of extremely disgusting mana, and then it exploded.
target: Corpus ad obex cum extrema velocitate pervenit, et Sam brevem pulsationem vis arcanae, valde contaminatae, sensit, deinde illa explodit.

source: The lord of the manor let out an anguished roar, but thanks to his senses, Sam saw enough and knew that while everybody was hurt thanks to the explosion (while he remained stable, Mana Shield was eroded on several spots on his body causing several small wounds to appear) the shield protecting the ritual was still intact.
target: Dominus manerii clamor vastus edidit, sed gratias sensibus suis, Sam satis vidit et intellexit quod, quamquam omnes ex explosione laesi erant (dum ipse stabile manebat, Scutum Vis Arcanae in variis partibus corporis eius corrodere consequebatur, parva vulnera efficiens), scutum, quod ritum protegebat, adhuc intactum manebat.

source: Then, as the guards groaned on the ground, and the crying of the maids intensified, there was a small crack.
target: Tum, dum custodes in terra gemebant, et ancillae plorabant, parva fissura apparuit.

source: Then another and another, until everybody could hear the tinkling of something like glass falling and hitting the ground.
target: Deinde altera et altera, donec omnes audire poterunt sonitum quasi vitrei, cadentis et terram percutientis.

source: Through his magical senses, Sam watched as the ritual shield broke down, leaving the participants exposed to the elements.
target: Per sensus magicos suos, Sam vidit scutum ritus confractum esse, relinquens participantes elementis patefactos.

source: Sending a brief burst of unshaped wind at the garden, he sent the dust cloud away that was kicked up after the explosion.
target: Mittens breve impetum venti informis in hortum, nubem pulveris, quae post explosionem ortum erat, abiecit.

source: The moment the dust was cleared away, the Lord took a hesitant step forward and cried out with relief.
target: Quum pulvis deleptus est, Dominus gradum dubitans in antecessum fecit et cum solatio clamavit.

source: “My darling Sylvia!”
target: “Carissima mea Sylvia!”

source: The lady of the house couldn’t answer as she was currently writhing deliriously upon her divan, while the black smoke rising from her body seemed to be being sucked into the Chalice of Restraint while the white flames burned with an intensity that made it hard to look at it.
target: Domina domus respondere non poterat, cum delirius in divano suo convulsabatur, dum niger fumus e corpore eius surgere videbatur et in Calyce Coercitionis attrahi, dum flammae albae tanta intensitate ardebant ut difficile essent contemplandae.

source: All his senses were focused on the lady and the transfer of the parasite from her weakened body into the purifying flames of the Chalice, so it was rather understandable that neither Sam nor anybody else from the household noticed as one of the maids hesitantly began to walk towards the lady of the house.
target: Omnes sensus eius in domina et in translatione parasiti ex corpore eius debilitato in flammas purificantes Calycei intendebant, ita ut satis intellegendum esset neque Sam neque alii ex familia observaverunt, cum una ex ancillis dubitatione ad dominam domus ambulare coepit.

source: His head, however, snapped up from witnessing some rather impressive magic when the very familiar and oh‑so‑hated magic of the dark being returned with a rather small pulse.
target: Caput eius, tamen, subitamente elevatum est, dum aliquid magiae mirabilis observeret, cum vis magica nota atque vehementer odenda entis obscuri parvo impetu rediret.

source: It took only a second for him to find the maid within striking distance of Lady Sylvia, with eyes darker than the darkest night.
target: Unam secundam tantum exigebat ut ancillam in intervallo percutiendi Dominae Sylviae inveniret, oculis nigrioribus quam tenebris obscurissimae noctis.

source: The dark being in the guise of the woman sent him a brief smirk, then raised a sword retrieved from who knows where wreathed in eldritch darkness that seemed to drip misery and struck with reckless abandon.
target: Ens obscurum in forma feminae ei brevem subridens misit, deinde gladium ex ignoto loco evocatum, in tenebris arcani involutum, quae miseriam stillare videbantur, sublevavit et impetu temerario percussit.

source: Then a lot of things happened in a short amount of time.
target: Tum multa in brevi tempore acciderunt.

source: The guards all yelled out, the maids were crying even louder and the man standing next to Sam let out another anguished roar.
target: Custodes omnes clamaverunt, ancillae etiam vehementius flevere, et vir iuxta Sam iterum clamor dolore exemit.

source: “SYLVIA! NOO!”
target: “SYLVIA! NON!”

source: But everybody knew that they would be too late to save the lady’s life.
target: Sed omnes sciebant se sero fore ne vitam dominae servare possent.

source: The only one who didn’t move was Sam, who answered the being’s smirk with a smirk of his own.
target: Solus, qui non movebatur, erat Sam, qui subridens propriam subridentem responsionem dedit.

source: At the exact moment the maid’s hand holding the sword got near the woman, the shadows next to her bubbled, and Lucky, like a shark made of shadows, launched upwards and bit her on the hand, stopping the attack entirely.
target: Ex illo momento quo manus ancillae gladium tenens prope mulierem accedebat, umbrae iuxta eam bullaverunt, et Lucky, ut selachus ex umbris compositus, surrexit et in manum eius mordebat, totum impetum sistens.
